newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: WTO panel to rule on Turkish tax on foreign films.
newsitem.headline: WTO panel to rule on Turkish tax on foreign films.

text.p: The World Trade Organisation (WTO) established a dispute settlement panel to rule on a U.S. complaint against Turkey's 25 percent tax on box office receipts generated by the showing of foreign films, a WTO spokesman said.

The United States told the WTO Dispute Settlement Body that Turkey's municipality tax discriminated against foreign-origin films as no such tax was imposed on box office receipts from the showing of domestic films, according to trade sources.
Both the U.S. and Turkish trade delegations said they hoped that a solution could be found to the dispute which began last year.
Canada reserved its rights as a third-party to the dispute, according to trade sources.
